contract.probe_direction: one fixed TRAIN real-successor direction for every world
contract.generated_probe: fit independently per checkpoint on TRAIN logged transitions; evaluate only on whole held-out DEV episodes
contract.evaluation: whole held-out episodes; expert and epsilon support reported separately

contract.split: the production whole-episode split, expert and support separately

whitening_gate.rule: launch only when the held-out observed direction is decodable, its TRAIN variance is below the isotropic average, and at least one production reset stratum has both fixed-direction and fresh-probe gaps, then shows lower total/orthogonal error but non-improving directional error and correlation from 5k to 80k
